column2: How does the functional division of the liver differ from its anatomical lobes?
column3: Anatomical lobes are separated by the falciform ligament on the surface; the functional plane follows portal inflow and biliary drainage along the middle hepatic vein from gallbladder fossa to inferior vena cava.
